program.purpose: Standardize how VyrnForge source, generated reference data, executable examples, CI evidence, deployed reference sites, and release snapshots move through one traceable lifecycle before component expansion resumes.

readerSurfaces.role: executable examples, component/pattern exploration, and reference views
readerSurfaces.target: general VyrnForge playground identity rather than data-grid-specific ownership

lifecycle.policy: affected-scope validation plus ci-gate on the owning integration lane
full repository validation plus ci-gate before integration lane promotion to main
delivery-only rebuild of docs/playground/reference output bound to the exact main commit
consume and verify an immutable successful current-main delivery artifact; never rebuild source in the deployment workflow
full quality/integration, compatibility, security drift, CodeQL, and persistent-lane drift; never publish or deploy
manual current-main release using verified immutable tarballs, trusted publishing, registry verification, and release records

artifacts.lineage: exact Git commit + successful current-main CI run + tarball digests

gaps.description: Generated framework API reference exists, but reader-facing component demo pages still contain hand-maintained API tables/examples that can drift from canonical contracts.
Docs and playground are separate applications with separate context code and need one shared reference-site vocabulary and navigation/version contract.
Framework usage snippets exist, but executable example ownership is not yet standardized as one canonical example registry verified across all four first-class surfaces.
PRs validate docs/playground builds but do not yet emit one standardized non-privileged reference preview artifact.
Versioned reference assembly discovers Git release tags during a later exact-main delivery build, so a successful release does not yet refresh the released reference snapshot immediately.

requiredBeforeClose: generated API reference is reader-facing and drift-checked
docs and playground share one version/framework/reference contract
representative examples are verified across Native HTML, React, Angular, and Vue
PR reference preview artifact is available without deployment permissions
current-main reference deployment consumes immutable artifacts only
successful release refreshes the exact tagged reference snapshot without another source commit
